_comment: Copy this file to kecon-resources.json and edit the paths for your machine.
kecon-resources.json is git-ignored on purpose: these paths are per-machine
and often personal, so they must never be committed.
Resolution order for every value below is:
CLI flag  ->  environment variable  ->  this file  ->  built-in probing
so any single value can be overridden without editing the file.
Run `python scripts/xcskr_tool.py resources` to see what was resolved and
which source each value came from.
Every key is optional. Omit a key to let the tool derive or probe it.
_install_dir: xRobotDesigner install root, the folder containing Resource/. Env: KECON_INSTALL_DIR. Probed from a short list of common install paths when absent.
_lang: Resource language folder: chs | eng | enu | jan. Env: KECON_LANG. When absent, every installed language is searched in that order.
_version: Version folder under Resource/<lang>/history, or "latest". Env: KECON_VERSION. Pin it to reproduce results against one library version.
_fb_lib_dir: Override the function block library folder (…/FBLib/MRC). Env: KECON_FB_LIB_DIR. Normally derived from install_dir + lang + version. This library is the authority on function block pin names and order.
_datatype_dir: Override the vendor data type library folder (…/DataType). Env: KECON_DATATYPE_DIR. Holds the chassis and system struct definitions a project can import.
_help_files: Extra help files to record, e.g. manuals kept outside the install. The Resource/<lang>/HelpFile folder is picked up automatically. The .chm can be unpacked with 7-Zip; its topic pages are GBK-encoded HTML.
_sample_projects: Folders (searched recursively) or single .xcskr files holding official sample projects. Env: KECON_SAMPLES_DIR. These are GUI-authored, which makes them the ground truth for file shape whenever the tool has to reproduce something the GUI writes.
